decisions.reason: A cheap accessory with little sunk investment or public commitment carries little escalation pressure, but it costs almost nothing to keep and fits the accessories and spare-parts range.

A multi-model box trailer line featured on the home page represents substantial sunk investment and visible commitment in the core business, so management will persist and treat weak results as temporary, including pandemic-related disruption.
The car transporter line's heavy tooling and development costs, and its role in reaching professional users and international markets, call for justification and continued commitment.
The low-bed series is central to the announced product range and was publicly showcased, so sunk costs and the need to justify earlier decisions favour keeping it.
